caption:
Solar Words, Straight #2: kW vs. kWh. One letter apart, and the mix-up behind most confusing solar quotes.

Follow for more plain-English Oʻahu solar math.

#Oahu #HawaiiSolar #SolarPower #HawaiianElectric #Honolulu

slides.text: kW and kWh are not the same thing. Your quote uses both.
kW = how big the system is.
slides.sub: Like the size of a faucet.

slides.text: kWh = how much energy the system makes.
slides.sub: Like how much water ends up in the bucket.

slides.label: 1 kW running for 1 hour = 1 kWh.
slides.sub: Your bill counts kWh. Your quote sells kW.
“How many kWh a year will this make, and how does that compare to my last 12 bills?”

items: Definition: kilowatt (kW) is a rate of power; kilowatt-hour (kWh) is energy, 1 kW sustained for 1 hour (U.S. EIA, “Electricity explained”).
